welcome.title: Welcome to PerkOS
welcome.description: PerkOS is your command center for AI-first accountable work. Organize your agents, dispatch tasks, and track results, all in one place. Let's get you set up in a few quick steps.
welcome.emptyNote: Your dashboard starts empty. By the end of this setup, you'll have your first project and agent ready to go.

project.description: Projects keep your agents and tasks organized around a shared goal. Think of each project as a mission with its own scope, agents assigned, and tasks to complete.

hibernation.title: Hibernation
hibernation.description: Pause the agent's container to stop billing while you're not using it — sending a message wakes it back up. On the latest runtime its state is snapshotted (encrypted) and restored on wake; agents on older images restart fresh.
hibernation.noBackups: No backups yet. Encrypted state snapshots are captured automatically every few minutes while the agent runs and restored when it wakes. Agents on older runtime images restart fresh.
hibernation.encrypted: Encrypted client-side (AES-256) before upload — only your agent can decrypt them.
hibernation.confirmDescription: Stops the running container and pauses billing. Sending a message wakes it (~30–60s to come back). On the latest runtime its encrypted state is restored on wake; agents on older images restart fresh.
hibernation.restoreDescription: The agent will restart with its state from {{backup}}. Anything changed since then is replaced (~30–60s to come back).
hibernation.hibernatingToast: {{name}} is hibernating — billing will stop once the task drains.
hibernation.startingToast: {{name}} is starting back up — give it ~30s to be ready.
hibernation.retentionToast: Keeping the last {{count}} backups — applies after the next restart.
hibernation.restoringToast: Restoring {{name}} — it will restart with that backup (~30–60s).

upgrade.confirmDescription: PerkOS will pause the current container, install {{tag}}, and restore the encrypted state in a new container. The agent will be unavailable for approximately 60–90 seconds; memory and conversation history are preserved.
